Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.ml.dataset.encoding

Interface ActionVectorTranslator

All Known Implementing Classes:
OneHotActionVectorEncoder
public interface ActionVectorTranslator
Interface for bidirectional translation between ActionConfig and ActionVectors.

This interface defines the contract for converting GUI automation actions into numerical vectors suitable for machine learning, and vice versa. Different implementations can provide various encoding strategies (e.g., one-hot encoding, continuous encoding) based on the specific requirements of the ML model being used.

Implementations should ensure that the translation is as lossless as possible, preserving all relevant information needed to reconstruct the original action from its vector representation.

  • Method Details

    • toVector

      ActionVector toVector(ActionResult matches)
      Converts an action result into a numerical vector representation.

      This method extracts relevant information from the ActionResult, including the action configuration and execution results (such as matched coordinates), and encodes them into a fixed-size numerical vector suitable for ML processing.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult containing the action configuration and execution results
      Returns:
      An ActionVector containing the numerical representation of the action

    • toActionConfig

      ActionConfig toActionConfig(ActionVector actionVector)
      Reconstructs ActionConfig from a numerical vector representation.

      This method performs the inverse operation of toVector, reconstructing the action configuration from its numerical representation. Note that some information may be lost in the translation process depending on the encoding strategy used.

      Parameters:
      actionVector - The numerical vector representation of an action
      Returns:
      ActionConfig reconstructed from the vector
